dialogs.text: Gone again... Um... Traveler! Could you please do me a favor?
My food is missing!
Uh, no, that can't be it! My pet snakes' food — that's what's missing!
How did it go? Did you find the food?
There's special food for pet snakes? Don't they eat mice and stuff?
Yes, they did hunt by themselves in the past.
But ever since they startled several children whilst feeding, I have banned them from going out without me. I've started mixing food for them.
*sigh* But after that, they haven't been moving much, and have stubbornly refused to eat any other food.
*sigh* Paimon thought "there was no such thing as a free lunch"...
Delicious!
Paimon hasn't even asked about the flavor yet, so you can dream on!
Enjoying food is Paimon's job!
Uh huh. Very reasonable of you.
I must have left their food at one of my camps when I was out picking herbs.
But I can't really leave, what with all my little fellas to care for and stuff. I don't want them scaring anyone again when they search for food...
Traveler, would you mind visiting that campsite and fetching the food for me?
Leave it to me.
Thank you so much. Who knows what accidents we might run into if I were to go there with these little fellas.
If they got it into their heads to go playing around in the forest for a few days, I'd be doomed...
Anyway, I'll be leaving this to you, Traveler.
I'll mark all the camps I've stayed at on the map for you, so please take a look at those spots.
There aren't any other snakes at the campsites, right...?
No, not at all. I set all my camps up away from snake lairs precisely so that we could stay out of trouble...
How many camps have you got, again?
Well, I set up a few while I was living in the rainforest.
I've already stopped living in the rainforest, but I still do rest at my campsites if I collect herbs there.
Absolutely delicious!
Paimon's sure we've met someone with a snake for a pet before... Right! It's that weirdo named Baizhu...
I don't think Changsheng counts as a "pet"...

dialogs.text: You are back! I gotta say, that was quick. Did you find the food?
Is this what you're looking for?
Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.
When we arrived, there were Fungi that were trying to swipe it.
Fungi, huh... Phew, guess I was lucky to have you go instead. Thank you so much, Traveler.
I can't thank you enough. Please, accept this as your payment.
Here's your meal, little fellas...
Yes, these would do! Thank you so much.
Why weren't these in the camp, but on the nearby tree?
Well... Maybe the birds had them stashed away for a rainy day...
Is this stuff so popular with animals? Maybe I should start a business...
Ahem! Don't mind me. Thank you very much. Here's your payment.
Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.
It was buried under the rocks. Your camp seems to have gotten caught in a landslide that carried your stuff far away. We spent a long while looking, actually.
Seriously? How could there be a landslide? That spot has never been in any trouble...
Oh! When I was camping there, I could hear strange sounds at night, and I could feel something scratching at my tent...
My snakes were alert and would wake me every time. But I never found anything no matter how many times I checked...
Eh, you know what, forget about it... Thanks for your help. Here's your payment.
Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.
About the camp...
I see... Was it the work of wild animals...?
Now that you mention it, the food I made attracted Fungi and birds... So, attracting wild animals sounds about right...
Guess I should really consider starting a feed-selling business...
If that turns out well, I could be making much more money than I do now by putting up performances...
Oh, sorry, I'm getting off-topic... Thanks for your help, and please, take your payment.
Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.
Why is your camp in the middle of a bunch of thorny vines!? Wouldn't you get hurt sleeping there?
Nah, I'm pretty skilled when it comes to living in the wild.
And there weren't that many vines around when I established that camp.
Have you been away from the forest for a very long time?
Sort of. I can't remember the details.
Hahaha, I'm really rusty when it comes to setting up camps now.
Most of the camps I've set up in the past have been abandoned.
What kind of life would I be leading had I remained in the rainforest...?
...Sorry, I've said too much. Here is your payment. Please take it.
What's the matter? Anything else on your mind?
I found something else in the camp.
Huh? This bead... How... Where did you find this?
Inside a pot in the camp. Did you leave that behind?
Ah, it was used in past shows. Whenever I play the flute, my little fellas would carry that bead on their heads and dance with their upper bodies in the air.
But tricks of this kind have long ceased being profitable, and I haven't performed for quite some time either. I didn't even notice that it had gone missing...
Anyway, thanks for bringing it back. Here's your payment, please take it.
What's the matter? Anything else on your mind?
I found something else in the camp.
Huh? These hats... Hahaha, I made them for the snakes. How did I even forget these?
I made each of them a nightcap so that they could attract children to the show.
Red for Jori, green for Amum, yellow for Gana, and blue for Drak...
Sounds cute! The show must've been a hit!
It went well at first, but the children would burst into tears whenever the snakes opened their jaws...
Oh, forget about it... Please take this as your payment. It's something, at least.
What's the matter? Anything else on your mind?
I found something else in the camp.
Ah! Isn't this the snake climbing tower I made? Wow, this sure brings back some memories! Hahaha!
Snake climbing tower? What even is that?
Just a toy for the snakes to climb on. I can't have them hanging on me all the time, you know?
Thanks for bringing it back. Please take this as your payment.
So I designed it like that? Hah, this sure does bring back some memories...
